question: How should leaves, flowers, incense, and similar items be arranged as offerings?
premises: Leaves, flowers, and similar items are to be offered.
Incense and similar items are likewise to be offered.
Each item should be arranged one by one.
inference: One should arrange leaves, flowers, incense, and similar offerings one by one.
plain_english: One should arrange leaves, flowers, and so on, and likewise incense and so on, one by one.
